name: spacetime-tracking
title: Spacetime Tracking
description: Track how much time you spend in each macOS space, with inactivity detection and CSV export.
author: olivier_bossel

commands.name: tracker
commands.title: Menubar
commands.subtitle: Spacetime Tracking
commands.description: Menu bar tracker: start/stop a session and record time per macOS space.

commands.name: sessions
commands.title: Sessions
commands.subtitle: Spacetime Tracking
commands.description: Browse recorded sessions, view per-space breakdowns and export to CSV.

commands.name: spaces
commands.title: Spaces
commands.subtitle: Spacetime Tracking
commands.description: List your macOS spaces: switch to one, or rename it. Names are used everywhere time is shown.

commands.name: name-current
commands.title: Rename Space
commands.subtitle: Spacetime Tracking
commands.description: Name the space you're currently on.

commands.name: setup
commands.title: Setup
commands.subtitle: Spacetime Tracking
commands.description: Apply the macOS settings and permissions the extension needs to switch spaces.

commands.name: start-session
commands.title: New Session
commands.subtitle: Spacetime Tracking
commands.description: Start a new time-tracking session (replacing any current one).

commands.name: export-last-session
commands.title: Export Last Session
commands.subtitle: Spacetime Tracking
commands.description: Export the most recent session to a CSV file, choosing where to save it.

preferences.name: inactivityEnabled
preferences.title: Inactivity Detection
preferences.label: Pause tracking when idle
preferences.description: When enabled, tracking pauses automatically after a period of no keyboard/mouse activity.

preferences.name: inactivityMinutes
preferences.title: Idle Threshold (minutes)
preferences.description: How many minutes of inactivity before tracking auto-pauses.

preferences.name: keepTrackingWhileMedia
preferences.title: Media Playback
preferences.label: Keep tracking while media is playing
preferences.description: Don't auto-pause when an app is playing video/audio or otherwise keeping the display awake (e.g. watching a video or presenting).

preferences.name: splitAtMidnight
preferences.title: Keep Sessions Within One Day
preferences.label: Split a session at midnight
preferences.description: When enabled, a session that crosses midnight is stopped at 00:00 and a new session starts at 00:01 (or at your next activity). When disabled, a session may span multiple days.

preferences.name: autoDailySession
preferences.title: Automatic Daily Session
preferences.label: Record a session automatically every day
preferences.description: Automatically start a new session once a day (when you first use your computer), with no action.

preferences.name: autoSaveSessions
preferences.title: Save Sessions to Disk
preferences.label: Export each session to CSV when it stops
preferences.description: When a session is stopped (or replaced by a new one), automatically write it as a CSV file to the folder below.

preferences.name: autoSaveDirectory
preferences.title: Sessions Folder
preferences.description: Folder where stopped sessions are saved as CSV. Defaults to Downloads if left empty.

preferences.name: autoSaveSubfolders
preferences.title: Organize by Year/Month
preferences.label: Save into <year>/<month> subfolders
preferences.description: Nest saved CSV files under year/month folders, e.g. 2026/07/session-2026-07-06-15h23.csv.

preferences.name: minSpaceMinutes
preferences.title: Minimum Space Time (minutes)
preferences.description: Hide spaces with less than this many minutes from the session breakdown and exported rows. The session total always counts every space. Leave empty to show all spaces.
